fields.name: Central TIAC Tracking ID
fields.description: Tracking ID of a TIAC record from Central Tenant

fields.name: Enrichments
fields.description: Raw or structured enrichment data from TI lookups; use for detailed context when drilling into a TI artifact.

fields.name: First Created
fields.description: Timestamp when the TI artifact was first created; use for aging and reporting.

fields.name: History
fields.description: System audit history of changes to the TI artifact; use for compliance and troubleshooting.

fields.name: Last Seen
fields.description: When the observable was last seen; use for freshness of intelligence.

fields.name: Last Updated
fields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated; use for staleness.

fields.name: Merged Risk Scores
fields.description: JSON or structured data of risk scores from multiple TI sources; use for detailed risk breakdown when analyzing a TI reference.

fields.name: Observable
fields.description: The observable value (IP, domain, hash, URL, etc.) that was enriched; primary identifier when a Signal or Case references this TI artifact.

fields.name: Observable File
fields.description: Attachment containing the observable (e.g. file submitted for analysis); use when the artifact is file-based.

fields.name: Observable Type
fields.description: Type of the observable; use to interpret the Observable value and for IOC context. Allowed values: file, ipv4_public, ipv4_private, ipv6_public, ipv6_private, domain, email, url, md5, sha1, sha256.

fields.name: Read Only
fields.description: Flag indicating the record is read-only; UI and automation control. Allowed value: Read Only.

fields.name: Threat Intelligence Verdict
fields.description: Verdict from threat intelligence enrichment (e.g. Unknown, Informational, Benign, Suspicious, Malicious); use for triage and to align with Intelligence Verdict on the signal.

fields.name: TI Last Updated
fields.description: When the TI artifact was last updated; use for staleness of enrichment.

fields.name: TIAC Last Synced
fields.description: Timestamp when TIA Record is pushed to; or pulled from Central TIAC

fields.name: Turbine Risk Score
fields.description: Numeric risk score from Turbine aggregation; use with verdict and severity for prioritization.
